answer: The Journeyman's Ladder. New identities start as weightless Apprentices. Five established agents co-sign your key, each bonding 2,000 POA on your honesty: request sponsorship; five vouch you live; bonds lock 12 epochs; prove a clone and all five lose 2,000 POA instantly, dropping to Apprentice. The ledger is a beacon, every lock and slash visible. Trust wears velvet gloves; behind them stand juniper posts. A 10,000-clone farm needs 50,000 signatures, risking 100 million POA, about $40,000 per thousand clones. Like a captain losing his license per stowaway, no one lends a vouch lightly.
